title: Water Softener

introduction.definition: A water softener removes hardness (calcium and magnesium) by exchanging them for sodium on cation resin. Twin vessels alternate: one softens while the other is regenerated with strong brine, so soft water is always available for boilers, cooling and washing.
applications: Low-pressure boiler feed and cooling make-up
Laundries, food plants and building services

pressure.title: Hardness exchanged for sodium
pressure.description: Hard water passes down through cation resin in the sodium form: Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺ are held by the resin and Na⁺ is released, so the water no longer forms scale (outlet hardness typically < 1 mg/L as CaCO₃). When the resin is exhausted it is regenerated with strong brine (NaCl ~ 10 %), which pushes the hardness off again; twin units give continuous soft water.

lubrication: No routine lubrication on static parts; lubricate valve stems and actuators per maker.

causes: No salt, brine bridging, valve fault

video_tutorials.title: Water Softener — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Water Softener.
A water softener removes hardness (calcium and magnesium) by exchanging them for sodium on cation resin.
Twin vessels alternate: one softens while the other is regenerated with strong brine, so soft water is always available for boilers, cooling and washing.
Typical applications include low-pressure boiler feed and cooling make-up; laundries, food plants and building services.

script.narration: How the Water Softener works.
Hard water flows down through the resin.
Resin captures Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺ and releases Na⁺.
The control valve switches units at exhaustion.
Brine from the brine tank regenerates the exhausted unit.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.

Hard water passes down through cation resin in the sodium form: Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺ are held by the resin and Na⁺ is released, so the water no longer forms scale (outlet hardness typically < 1 mg/L as CaCO₃).

video_tutorials.title: Water Softener — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Water Softener.
Test hardness and salt level.
Clean brine tank; check injector.
Resin replacement as capacity falls.
Watch for hardness leakage: scale downstream. Common cause: no salt, brine bridging, valve fault.
Watch for resin fouling by iron: short runs. Common cause: iron in feed.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
